scope: Bounded original-top10 local geometry repair, 198 rebuilt VHL reference heads and 198 tested kinase-head transfers; no production docking, new MD, GNN fitting or historical chemistry replacement.
preserve: All original PDBs, MD, labels and previous results unchanged. Local derivatives only.
note: Internal0.6A gate is stricter than earlier0.8A diagnostic. Internal neighbor exclusions are graph distances1 and2. Heavy-atom overlap proxy is not a MolProbity clashscore or binding validation.
reference_method: Deposited bound-parent fragments verified through CCD atom IDs, ELOC fitting for VHL; existing sequence/CE pocket coverage/core gates for kinase transfer; none relaxed.
